name: Trail Run BR
privacyDescription: Only members can see who's in the community and what they post.
about: A community for people who run on dirt, rocks and mountains in Brazil. Weekend group runs, race recaps, gear talk and trail conditions. All paces welcome, walking the uphills is mandatory.

rules.title: Be kind and welcoming
rules.text: Everyone was a beginner once. No pace shaming, no gear shaming.

rules.title: Leave no trace
rules.text: Take your trash home. Stay on marked trails. Respect wildlife and hikers.

rules.title: Safety first
rules.text: Share trail conditions, weather alerts and closures as soon as you know them.

rules.title: Keep it about trails
rules.text: No ads, no selling, no unrelated promotions.

rules.title: What's shared here, stays here
rules.text: Posts and stories in this community cannot be shared outside of it. Respect your fellow members.
